mainEntity.name: Does Frasheski Construction offer services beyond painting, such as repairs or drywall work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Frasheski Construction offers a comprehensive range of services beyond just painting and finishing. This often includes necessary surface preparation, such as drywall repair, patching, and minor carpentry work that ensures a smooth and professional finish. We address underlying issues to provide a durable and high-quality result, integrating these services into our project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Frasheski Construction also provides surface preparation, including drywall repair and minor carpentry, as part of our services.
